results.text: Backups go to the nightly S3 bucket with 30-day retention.
Release notes are generated by changesets on every release PR.
Import statements are kept sorted alphabetically, enforced by the ESLint import/order rule.
Authorization is enforced by the policy engine; the identity module (renamed from auth) reads its configuration from identity.yaml.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.internal:7070.
Prometheus scrapes the /metrics path every 15 seconds.
